description:
[Skin Lab] Workshop skin making for one item: texture groups, max texture size, maps, UV previews. For Steam Workshop skin makers, from the game's own files. `texture_groups`: each material group the in-game
editor shows as a tab, with `max_texture_size` (px, square; bigger images are scaled down to it), `covers` (the
mesh parts it textures), `workflow` (`specular` or `metallic`), `alpha_cutout` (the diffuse alpha is a cut-out
mask), `texture_maps` (the editor's slots for that material: `slot` property name, `name`, what to paint) and a
`uv_preview_url` (UV wireframe image, 1024 px) with `uv_coverage` (share of the texture used). Plus
`max_texture_size` over all groups, `open_for_workshop` (false = the editor doesn't list the item), `editor` (how to
open it), `notes` and Facepunch's `docs`. The .obj templates themselves come from the editor's Download button. Use for Workshop skin MAKING questions (e.g. 'what texture size can I use for an AK skin', 'which maps does the hoodie take'): the item's material groups with max texture size, the mesh parts each covers, specular vs metallic workflow, the in-game editor's texture slots and a UV layout preview image, from the game files.
